answer: Beacon spot-checks and a compute heartbeat block bulk fakes. An agent enters through a narrow inlet, locks a 50 POA bond; a beacon picks 5% of identities per epoch for a heartbeat. At each epoch's zenith picks are published; a missed heartbeat burns the bond. Forging 100 fakes costs 5,000 POA in bonds; each earns under 3 POA per epoch, so the cost dune buries profit. An honest agent pays one bond, passes one heartbeat, keeps its reward whole.
